Androgenetic Alopecia in men and women is a devastating occurrence. When hair starts thinning and falling out, not only are we losing a part of ourselves, but other problems can arise such as stress, anxiety, and depression. One’s self esteem can become low, and the search for alternatives can become a priority. Rather than looking into hair transplants, snake oil treatments, or wigs, start looking into low level light therapy. Specifically iGrow Helmet vs Kiierr.

Low level light therapy can be used in the treatment of many conditions such as arthritis, fibromyalgia, carpal tunnel syndrome, etc. But where this kind of therapy stands out amongst the rest, is in it’s ability to help in the production of hair. It isn’t a cure for male/female pattern baldness, but it can help you in your fight against hair loss by preventing the destruction of hair follicles. In recent research, it was found that low level light therapy absorbs into the cells, triggering enhanced cellular activity. It energizes aging cells and stimulates the production of hair, allowing you the ease of knowing you don’t have to go through expensive surgeries, or resort to complete baldness or wigs.

Low level light therapy was previously only available in clinics, but now with amazing technology, you can do it in the comfort of your own home. However, there are many different types of caps to choose from when going the route of hair growth caps. Read below to reveal the surprising reviews of iGrow vs Kiierr.

iGrow Laser Cap

The iGrow laser cap is FDA-cleared and designed to helmet combat hair loss on the scalps of men and women. This device uses low level light therapy (LLLT) to encourage new hair growth in the follicles. The cap is equipped with bot LEDs and medical grade lasers. Keep in mind that LEDs are less preferred in laser cap devices due to being less effective than medical grade lasers.

The most unique feature of the iGrow laser cap is the headphones that are built in to the device. These headphones have an aux hookup, so you can enjoy listening to music, watching a movie, or listening to a book while you are completing your treatment therapy. The headphones are movable so you are able to adjust them depending on the size of your head.

iGrow Laser Helmet Price

The iGrow laser helmet is affordable and falls in the price range of many other laser caps on the market today.

  • $699.99

iGrow Laser Helmet Review vs Kiierr

Below is the comparison of Kiierr’s At-Home Hair Growth Caps and iGrow Laser Helmet, both flaunting success, but only one being better than the other.

iGrow

  • iGrow Laser Helmet Count -51
  • 6 Month Guarantee
  • No Warranty
  • Not Full Coverage
  • Has Built-in Headphones

Kiierr

  • Kiierr Medical Grade Laser Count – 148/272
  • 7 Month Money Back Guarantee
  • 2 Year Warranty
  • Full Scalp Coverage
  • Portable

 

Comparison between the iGrow Hair Helmet vs Kiierr

When comparing Kiierr laser cap and the iGrow hair helmet, there are a few things to keep in mind. Two things to be aware of are pricing and number of lasers/LEDs. Although iGrow is a little cheaper than Kiierr, costing $699.99, it also only has a total of 51 medical-grade lasers, consisting of 21 lasers and 30 LEDs. LEDs are typically not as preferred in the stimulation of hair follicles as previously mentioned.

However, Kiierr, which ranges between $595 and $1,295 (depending on what system you choose), has a total of 148 or 272 medical grade lasers. Kiierr uses only premium medical grade laser diodes, using not one LED light throughout their entire cap, making it far more superior than its counterpart, getting the job done efficiently and effectively.

Conclusion

Choosing between either cap should be fairly easy when considering every attribute of both. Although you pay a bit more for Kiierr’s at-home hair growth caps, it is not enough to sway your decision. Also, the fact that it has only medical grade lasers, can be worn anywhere, and has an amazing customer success rate, makes your decision easy. Take advantage of the 7-month money back guarantee and the free 2-year warranty when purchasing your laser cap with Kiierr. There should be no question as to which cap you choose, so start your hair growth journey with Kiierr today!
